layers.name: road
layers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset for a cheerful side-scrolling 16-bit console platformer scene. Original art in the spirit of polished Super Nintendo era scenery, not a copy of a specific game. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, charming rounded forms, a restrained cohesive palette, warm golden sunlight from upper left, teal greens and distant lavender blues. Side-on view, no top-down perspective, no isometric perspective. Transparent alpha background, clean silhouette, no sky rectangle, no checkerboard painted into the artwork, no text, no logo, no characters, no people. One single horizontal layer only, wide landscape 3:1 strip with usable transparent space above it. The layer will move horizontally behind smooth vector game avatars, so all subjects and their bases must be readable from the side. Keep the left and right edges compatible for a seamless horizontal repeat; no border or shadow outside the cutout.
ASSET: ROAD AND GROUND STRIP. An uninterrupted level side-scrolling path with a thin lively green grass rim, a clearly walkable warm golden sandy top, then a visible ochre earth cross section with a few small rounded stones. A straight horizontal walking surface at about 30% from the top of the strip. The terrain occupies the bottom 70%; everything above the grass silhouette is fully transparent. Terrain reaches both horizontal edges at precisely the same height; the road is continuous, no floating islands, no gaps, no steps. Attractive clean ground texture with subtle variation, no trees, mountains, clouds or foreground bushes. Do not add letters or coins.
